_doc: The rebalance to tier 25 (the user's list of 2026-11-08b, docs/improvements9.txt, its fifth phase), carried to tier 30 by the list of 2026-11-12's sixth phase (docs/improvements12.txt: Heaven's dungeon the game's tiers 26-30, its gear Divine). Read by 910 and written onto every map of the game (brokenspire and the six dungeons). The game's tiers 1-30: each dungeon's five tiers mapped by its base and cap (also in dungeons/chain.json for the game's own tier, 905). Past tier 5 the monsters' hit points grow by health_growth a tier and their blows by damage_growth (the hero's power by power_growth and her hit points and mana by health_growth: 910 writes them as the generators' TierGrowthPower / TierGrowthHealth), their speed, pace and ability as tier 5's. Mage spells: one to each of the dungeons' 30 tiers (its tome's Slot), the 28 found before (in their old order: tier, then mana) and two made up. Gear: each tiered item again in each later dungeon at its tier there, in a quality (Fine, Masterwork, Exalted, Celestial, Divine), its damage by the tiers' power (880's rule: mistward/balance6.json's weapon_tier_power, past tier 5 x power_growth a tier), its armour, block and ring bonus a little more, its durability more; potions and food in each dungeon at their rank. Monsters: every dungeon's kinds on every map (weight 0 but on their own), the wilderness meeting each in its band of the game's tiers. Later abilities: one for the Summoner, the Rogue and the Martial Artist in each later dungeon (its last tier's boss), copies of their own abilities made stronger.
